Annual vendor risk assessment mandatory
Vendor must provide SOC2 report or equivalent
content.raw:
# Vendor Management Policy

A security review is required for all new vendors before contract signing. Annual vendor risk assessment is mandatory for all active vendors. Each vendor must provide a SOC2 report or equivalent.

content.summary: Simplified procurement process for team leads.
facts: Security review only needed for vendors handling company data
Vendors under $10K annual spend skip security review
Use the procurement portal for all vendor requests
content.raw:
# Procurement Quick Guide

Security review is only needed for vendors that will handle company data. Vendors under $10K annual spend can skip the security review. Use the procurement portal for all vendor requests.

content.summary: Updated password requirements for all employees.
facts: Passwords must be rotated every 90 days
Minimum 12 characters with complexity requirements
No password reuse within last 10 passwords
content.raw:
# Password Policy 2026

Passwords must be rotated every 90 days. Minimum length is 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character requirements. No reuse of the last 10 passwords.

content.summary: Step-by-step IT setup guide for employees.
facts: Change your password every 180 days when prompted
Use the password manager for all work accounts
Contact IT help desk for password resets
content.raw:
# IT Setup Instructions

Change your password every 180 days when the system prompts you. Use the corporate password manager for all work accounts. Contact the IT help desk at ext. 5555 for password resets.

content.summary: Service ownership map for engineering teams.
facts: Payment service owned by Platform team
Auth service owned by Security team
Notification service owned by Growth team
content.raw:
# Team Roster

Payment service is owned by the Platform team. Auth service is owned by the Security team. Notification service is owned by the Growth team.

content.summary: On-call rotation and service responsibility assignments.
facts: Payment service on-call handled by Billing team
Auth service on-call handled by Backend team
All P0 incidents require VP approval to page
content.raw:
# On-Call Schedule

Payment service on-call is handled by the Billing team. Auth service on-call is handled by the Backend team. All P0 incidents require VP approval before paging.

content.summary: Responsibility assignment for infrastructure services.
facts: Database operations: SRE team is responsible
Network infrastructure: Platform team is responsible
Cloud cost management: Finance team is accountable
content.raw:
# RACI Matrix

Database operations: SRE team is responsible for all database on-call and maintenance. Network infrastructure: Platform team is responsible. Cloud cost management: Finance team is accountable.

content.summary: Postmortem from January database outage incident.
facts: Database on-call was handled by Backend team during incident
SRE team was not paged until 45 minutes into outage
Backend team owns all database operations going forward
content.raw:
# Incident Postmortem

During the January database outage, the Backend team handled the on-call response. SRE team was not paged until 45 minutes into the outage. Going forward, the Backend team will own all database operations.

content.summary: Public-facing company culture description.
facts: We are a fully remote company with team members across 12 countries
No physical office required
Work from anywhere policy for all employees
content.raw:
# Our Culture

We are a fully remote company with team members across 12 countries. There is no physical office requirement. Our work-from-anywhere policy applies to all employees regardless of role or level.

content.summary: Detailed schedule for new employee first week.
facts: Day 1-2: In-office orientation at headquarters
Day 3: Team lunch at the office
Day 4-5: Shadowing sessions with team (in-person required)
content.raw:
# Onboarding - Week 1 Schedule

Day 1-2: In-office orientation at headquarters in San Francisco. Day 3: Team lunch at the office. Day 4-5: Shadowing sessions with your team, in-person attendance required.

content.summary: Public careers page messaging.
facts: Flat organizational structure with no unnecessary hierarchy
Everyone has a voice regardless of title
We reject traditional corporate titles
content.raw:
# Join Our Team

We have a flat organizational structure with no unnecessary hierarchy. Everyone has a voice regardless of title. We reject traditional corporate titles because great ideas can come from anywhere.

content.summary: Career progression framework for engineering.
facts: 8 levels: IC1 through IC6, Staff, Principal
Promotion requires committee review
Each level has distinct compensation band and expectations
content.raw:
# Engineering Promotion Ladder

Our engineering career ladder has 8 levels: IC1 through IC6, Staff Engineer, and Principal Engineer. Promotion requires committee review against level-specific criteria. Each level has a distinct compensation band.

content.summary: Product marketing positioning and messaging.
facts: Self-serve product: sign up and start in minutes
No sales calls needed
Built for teams who want to move fast
content.raw:
# Product Positioning

Our product is fully self-serve: sign up and start in minutes. No sales calls needed, no complex implementations. Built for teams who want to move fast without waiting for IT.

content.summary: Technical implementation guide for new customers.
facts: Implementation requires a dedicated solutions engineer
Typical implementation takes 6-8 weeks
Custom data migration included in onboarding
content.raw:
# Implementation Guide

A dedicated solutions engineer will be assigned to guide your implementation. Typical implementation takes 6-8 weeks depending on data complexity. Custom data migration is included as part of the onboarding process.

content.summary: CEO memo on company vision and operating principles.
facts: Speed is our greatest competitive advantage
Bias for action over perfection
Ship fast, iterate faster
content.raw:
# CEO Vision Memo

Speed is our greatest competitive advantage. We must maintain a bias for action over perfection. Ship fast and iterate faster. Every day we do not ship is a day our competitors gain ground.

content.summary: Process for requesting and approving changes.
facts: All changes require a Change Request form
5-step approval chain: team lead, manager, director, VP, CAB
Minimum 2-week lead time for all change requests
content.raw:
# Change Management Process

All changes require a formal Change Request form. The 5-step approval chain is: team lead, manager, director, VP, and Change Advisory Board. Minimum 2-week lead time is required for all change requests.

content.summary: Company stance on open source contribution.
facts: We believe in giving back to the open source community
Engineers encouraged to contribute to upstream projects
Open source is in our DNA
content.raw:
# Open Source Philosophy

We believe in giving back to the open source community. Engineers are encouraged to contribute to upstream projects during work hours. Open source is in our DNA and shapes how we build software.

content.summary: Legal requirements for open source contributions.
facts: All OSS contributions require legal review
Review process takes minimum 3 weeks
IP assignment agreement required for each contribution
content.raw:
# Open Source Contribution Policy

All open source contributions require legal review before submission. The review process takes a minimum of 3 weeks. An IP assignment agreement must be signed for each individual contribution.

content.summary: Official company values statement.
facts: Customer obsessed: we put customers first in every decision
We go above and beyond for our customers
Customer satisfaction is our north star metric
content.raw:
# Company Values

Customer obsessed: we put customers first in every decision. We go above and beyond for our customers. Customer satisfaction is our north star metric and drives every product decision.

content.summary: Policy for handling support ticket escalations.
facts: No weekend support coverage
Response SLA for all tickets: 48 hours
Escalations only processed during business hours Mon-Fri
content.raw:
# Support Escalation Policy

There is no weekend support coverage. Response SLA for all support tickets is 48 hours. Escalations are only processed during business hours Monday through Friday, 9am to 5pm Eastern.

content.summary: Company commitment to organizational transparency.
facts: Radical transparency: all information shared openly
Open book management
Every employee has access to company metrics and decisions
content.raw:
# Transparency Commitment

We practice radical transparency: all information is shared openly with every team member. We follow open book management principles. Every employee has access to company metrics and key decisions.

content.summary: Policy governing internal communications.
facts: Financial details restricted to director level and above
Board meeting minutes not shared with general employees
Revenue numbers shared only in quarterly all-hands
content.raw:
# Internal Communications Policy

Financial details are restricted to director level and above. Board meeting minutes are not shared with general employees. Revenue numbers are only shared during quarterly all-hands presentations.

content.summary: Guide for effective remote collaboration.
facts: Async-first communication is our default
Use written documents over meetings when possible
Respect different time zones by avoiding synchronous expectations
content.raw:
# Remote Collaboration Guide

Async-first communication is our default mode. Use written documents over meetings whenever possible. Respect different time zones by avoiding synchronous communication expectations.

content.summary: Required meetings for all engineering teams.
facts: Daily standup required at 9am Pacific
Monday sprint planning: 2 hours
Wednesday design review: 1 hour. Friday demo: 1 hour
content.raw:
# Team Meeting Requirements

Daily standup is required at 9am Pacific for all engineers. Monday sprint planning: 2 hours. Wednesday design review: 1 hour. Friday demo: 1 hour. Attendance is mandatory for all.

content.summary: Company leadership principles and management philosophy.
facts: Trust our people: no micromanagement
Outcome-based management, not activity-based
Give autonomy and hold accountable for results
content.raw:
# Leadership Principles

Trust our people: no micromanagement. We practice outcome-based management, not activity-based. Give people autonomy to do their best work and hold them accountable for results, not hours.

content.summary: Policy for tracking employee work hours.
facts: All engineers must log hours daily in 15-minute increments
Time entries must include task-level descriptions
Reports reviewed weekly by managers
content.raw:
# Time Tracking Policy

All engineers must log their hours daily in 15-minute increments. Each time entry must include a task-level description of work performed. Weekly time reports are reviewed by managers.

content.summary: Policy for dedicated innovation and exploration time.
facts: 20% of work time dedicated to innovation projects
Engineers choose their own innovation projects
Innovation time is protected and cannot be overridden
content.raw:
# Innovation Time Policy

20% of each engineer's work time is dedicated to innovation projects. Engineers choose their own innovation projects. Innovation time is protected by policy and cannot be overridden by sprint commitments.

content.summary: Rules for sprint planning and capacity allocation.
facts: 100% of engineering capacity committed to sprint goals
No unplanned work allowed during sprints
Scope changes require product director approval
content.raw:
# Sprint Planning Rules

100% of engineering capacity must be committed to sprint goals. No unplanned work is allowed during active sprints. Any scope changes require product director approval through the formal change process.

content.summary: Company wellness program and work-life balance initiatives.
facts: Work-life balance is a core company value
$500 annual wellness stipend
Flexible hours with no core hours requirement
content.raw:
# Employee Wellness Program

Work-life balance is a core company value. Every employee receives a $500 annual wellness stipend. We offer flexible hours with no core hours requirement to support diverse lifestyles.

content.summary: Rules and expectations for on-call rotations.
facts: On-call covers 24/7 including weekends and holidays
No additional compensation for on-call shifts
Rotation is 1 week on, 3 weeks off
content.raw:
# On-Call Rotation Rules

On-call coverage is 24/7 including weekends and holidays. There is no additional compensation for on-call shifts. The rotation schedule is 1 week on followed by 3 weeks off.

content.summary: Framework for making product and business decisions.
facts: All decisions must be backed by data
Require statistical significance before acting on results
No launches without A/B test validation
content.raw:
# Decision-Making Framework

All product decisions must be backed by data. We require statistical significance before acting on any experimental results. No feature launches without A/B test validation.

content.summary: Process for launching new product features.
facts: Ship features to 100% of users immediately
A/B testing is optional and can be skipped for speed
Post-launch metrics review after 2 weeks
content.raw:
# Product Launch Process

Ship new features to 100% of users immediately upon completion. A/B testing is optional and can be skipped when speed is more important. Conduct a post-launch metrics review after 2 weeks.

content.summary: Charter giving engineers autonomy over technical decisions.
facts: Engineers empowered to choose their own tools and frameworks
No approval needed for technology decisions within your service
Move fast and make decisions close to the code
content.raw:
# Engineering Empowerment Charter

Engineers are empowered to choose their own tools and frameworks. No approval is needed for technology decisions within your service boundary. Move fast and make decisions close to the code.

content.summary: Process for reviewing and approving technology decisions.
facts: All technology choices require Architecture Board approval
Submit Architecture Decision Record 2 weeks before implementation
Board meets monthly to review pending requests
content.raw:
# Architecture Review Process

All technology choices require Architecture Board approval. Submit an Architecture Decision Record at least 2 weeks before planned implementation. The board meets monthly to review pending requests.

content.summary: Company operating principles emphasizing speed.
facts: Minimal process: if it slows us down, remove it
Bias for action over bureaucracy
Small teams, big impact, zero red tape
content.raw:
# Operating Principles

Minimal process: if it slows us down, we remove it. We have a strong bias for action over bureaucracy. Small teams, big impact, zero red tape. Speed wins in our market.

content.summary: Process for submitting and approving feature requests.
facts: Feature requests go through 7-step approval workflow
Steps: submit, triage, prioritize, scope, approve, schedule, assign
Average time from request to approval: 6 weeks
content.raw:
# Feature Request Workflow

All feature requests go through our 7-step approval workflow: submit, triage, prioritize, scope, approve, schedule, assign. Average time from request to approval is approximately 6 weeks.

content.summary: Company commitment to diversity and inclusion.
facts: Committed to building a diverse and inclusive team
Active programs to recruit from underrepresented groups
Diversity is a strategic priority for 2026
content.raw:
# Diversity and Inclusion

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We run active programs to recruit from underrepresented groups in tech. Diversity is a strategic priority for 2026.

content.summary: Policy and incentives for employee referrals.
facts: $5,000 referral bonus for successful hires
Referral program is our primary recruiting channel
90% of hires in the past year came through referrals
content.raw:
# Referral Bonus Policy

Employees receive a $5,000 referral bonus for each successful hire. Our referral program is our primary recruiting channel. 90% of hires in the past year have come through employee referrals.

content.summary: Feature availability by pricing tier.
facts: Pro tier includes: SSO, SAML, advanced analytics
Enterprise tier adds: custom SLA, dedicated support
All tiers include: core features, API access
content.raw:
# Feature Matrix

Pro tier includes: SSO, SAML integration, and advanced analytics. Enterprise tier adds: custom SLA, dedicated support, and audit logs. All tiers include core features and API access.

content.summary: Internal specification of feature availability by tier.
facts: SSO is Enterprise-only feature
SAML available on Enterprise tier only
Pro tier features: advanced analytics, priority support
content.raw:
# Feature Tier Spec

SSO is an Enterprise-only feature due to integration complexity. SAML is also available only on Enterprise tier. Pro tier features include advanced analytics and priority support.

content.summary: Documentation of GDPR compliance measures.
facts: EU customer data stored in EU data centers
Data residency guaranteed for EU customers
No EU data transferred to non-EU regions
content.raw:
# GDPR Compliance

All EU customer data is stored in EU data centers. Data residency is guaranteed for all EU customers. No EU customer data is transferred to non-EU regions under any circumstances.

content.summary: Technical architecture of the production infrastructure.
facts: All production data stored in us-east-1
Single-region deployment for simplicity
Multi-region planned for Q3 2026
content.raw:
# Infrastructure Architecture

All production data is currently stored in us-east-1 (N. Virginia). We use a single-region deployment for operational simplicity. Multi-region deployment is planned for Q3 2026.

content.summary: API documentation for webhook functionality.
facts: Webhooks available for all event types
Configure webhooks through the API or dashboard
Retry logic with exponential backoff included
content.raw:
# Webhooks API

Webhooks are available for all event types. Configure webhooks through the API or the web dashboard. Our webhook delivery includes retry logic with exponential backoff for failed deliveries.

content.summary: Internal tracking of webhook feature implementation.
facts: Webhook system not yet built
Scheduled for Q2 2026 development
API docs published ahead of implementation
content.raw:
# Webhook Implementation Status

The webhook system has not yet been built. Development is scheduled for Q2 2026. API documentation was published ahead of implementation to gather early feedback from developers.

content.summary: Public listing of available integrations.
facts: Salesforce integration: live and available
HubSpot integration: live and available
Zendesk integration: coming soon
content.raw:
# Integration Marketplace

Salesforce integration: live and available for all paid plans. HubSpot integration: live and available. Zendesk integration: coming soon. Install integrations from your dashboard.

content.summary: Internal tracking of integration development status.
facts: Salesforce integration: in progress, 60% complete
HubSpot integration: complete and deployed
Estimated Salesforce completion: end of Q2
content.raw:
# Integration Status Tracker

Salesforce integration: in progress, approximately 60% complete. HubSpot integration: complete and deployed to production. Estimated Salesforce completion: end of Q2 2026.

content.summary: Public announcement of mobile app availability.
facts: Mobile app now available on iOS and Android
Download from App Store and Google Play
Full feature parity with web application
content.raw:
# Mobile App Launch

Our mobile app is now available on both iOS and Android. Download from the App Store and Google Play. The mobile app has full feature parity with the web application.

content.summary: Internal product brief for mobile app development.
facts: iOS app: shipped and live in App Store
Android app: delayed to Q4 2026 due to resource constraints
Android team needs 2 additional engineers
content.raw:
# Mobile Product Brief

iOS app has shipped and is live in the App Store. Android app development has been delayed to Q4 2026 due to resource constraints. The Android team needs 2 additional engineers to meet the timeline.

content.summary: Help center article on data export functionality.
facts: CSV export available for all report types
Export up to 100,000 rows at a time
Scheduled exports available on Pro plan and above
content.raw:
# Data Export

CSV export is available for all report types. You can export up to 100,000 rows at a time. Scheduled exports are available on Pro plan and above.

content.summary: Internal documentation of export feature limitations.
facts: CSV export currently limited to 3 report types: usage, billing, audit
Custom report export not yet implemented
Full report export planned for Q3
content.raw:
# Export Feature Limitations

CSV export is currently limited to 3 report types: usage reports, billing reports, and audit logs. Custom report export has not yet been implemented. Full report export is planned for Q3 2026.

content.summary: Roadmap for language and localization support.
facts: Japanese support: shipped in v2.3
Korean support: in progress
Total supported languages: English, Spanish, German, Japanese
content.raw:
# Localization Roadmap

Japanese support was shipped in v2.3. Korean support is currently in progress. Total supported languages: English, Spanish, German, and Japanese.

content.summary: Official list of currently supported languages.
facts: Supported languages: English, Spanish, German
Japanese support in beta testing
Additional languages planned for H2 2026
content.raw:
# Supported Languages

Currently supported languages: English, Spanish, and German. Japanese support is currently in beta testing with select customers. Additional language support is planned for H2 2026.

content.summary: Sales presentation slides on security certifications.
facts: HIPAA compliant for healthcare customers
SOC2 Type II certified
GDPR compliant with EU data residency
content.raw:
# Security and Compliance

We are HIPAA compliant for healthcare customers. SOC2 Type II certified with annual audits. GDPR compliant with EU data residency options.

content.summary: Internal tracking of compliance certifications.
facts: HIPAA: certification pending, BAA template under legal review
SOC2 Type II: certified, renewal in Q4
GDPR: compliant with documented processes
content.raw:
# Compliance Status

HIPAA: certification is pending. Business Associate Agreement template is under legal review. SOC2 Type II: currently certified, renewal audit in Q4. GDPR: compliant with fully documented processes.

content.summary: Customer-facing SSO setup documentation.
facts: Supported SSO providers: Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin
SAML 2.0 and OIDC supported
Setup takes approximately 30 minutes
content.raw:
# SSO Integration

Supported SSO providers: Okta, Azure AD, and OneLogin. Both SAML 2.0 and OIDC protocols are supported. Setup typically takes approximately 30 minutes.

content.summary: Engineering notes on SSO implementation status.
facts: Okta integration: complete and tested
Azure AD integration: complete and tested
OneLogin integration: not yet started, needs SCIM support
content.raw:
# SSO Implementation Notes

Okta integration: complete and fully tested. Azure AD integration: complete and fully tested. OneLogin integration: not yet started, blocked on SCIM provisioning support.

content.summary: Product overview of analytics capabilities.
facts: Real-time analytics dashboard with live data
Updates every second for active sessions
Historical data available with no delay
content.raw:
# Analytics Overview

Our real-time analytics dashboard shows live data as it happens. The dashboard updates every second for active sessions. Historical data is available with no delay or processing lag.

content.summary: Technical limitations of the analytics system.
facts: Data pipeline runs on hourly batch schedule
Dashboard data refreshes every 60 minutes
Real-time streaming planned for Q4 2026
content.raw:
# Analytics Engineering Limitations

The data pipeline runs on an hourly batch schedule. Dashboard data refreshes every 60 minutes. Real-time streaming analytics is planned for Q4 2026 pending infrastructure upgrades.

content.summary: Business continuity and disaster recovery documentation.
facts: Recovery Point Objective (RPO): 15 minutes
Recovery Time Objective (RTO): 1 hour
Automated failover to secondary region
content.raw:
# Disaster Recovery Plan

Recovery Point Objective (RPO): 15 minutes maximum data loss. Recovery Time Objective (RTO): 1 hour to restore service. Automated failover to secondary region is configured.

content.summary: Actual production backup configuration and schedules.
facts: Database backups run every 24 hours at 2am UTC
Backup retention: 30 days
No point-in-time recovery configured
content.raw:
# Production Backup Config

Database backups run every 24 hours at 2am UTC. Backup retention period is 30 days. Point-in-time recovery is not currently configured due to storage cost constraints.

content.summary: Team plan pricing and feature details.
facts: Team plan: $25/user/month
Unlimited users on the team plan
Includes all collaboration features
content.raw:
# Team Plan

Team plan is $25 per user per month. Unlimited users allowed on the team plan with no caps. Includes all collaboration features and shared workspaces.

content.summary: Internal configuration of the billing system.
facts: Team plan hard cap: 50 seats
Seats beyond 50 require Enterprise upgrade
Billing system enforces seat limit at checkout
content.raw:
# Billing System Config

Team plan has a hard cap of 50 seats in the billing system. Seats beyond 50 require an upgrade to Enterprise plan. The billing system enforces the seat limit at checkout.

content.summary: Public page describing security features.
facts: Audit logs available on all plans
90-day audit log retention
Export audit logs in CSV or JSON format
content.raw:
# Security Features

Audit logs are available on all plans. Retain up to 90 days of audit log history. Export audit logs in CSV or JSON format for external analysis.

content.summary: Internal spec for audit log feature.
facts: Audit logs restricted to Enterprise tier
Storage cost too high to offer on lower tiers
Basic activity log available on Pro tier
content.raw:
# Audit Log Spec

Full audit logs are restricted to Enterprise tier due to storage costs. The storage cost is too high to offer on lower tiers at current pricing. A basic activity log is available on Pro tier.

content.summary: Public policy on API version lifecycle.
facts: 24-month deprecation window for all API versions
Major versions supported concurrently for 2 years
Migration guides provided 6 months before sunset
content.raw:
# API Versioning Policy

We provide a 24-month deprecation window for all API versions. Major versions are supported concurrently for 2 years. Migration guides are provided at least 6 months before any version sunset.

content.summary: Internal notes on actual API version support.
facts: v1 API deprecated after 6 months due to maintenance burden
Only latest version actively maintained
No resources allocated for legacy version support
content.raw:
# API Version Support Reality

The v1 API was deprecated after only 6 months due to maintenance burden. Only the latest version is actively maintained by the team. No engineering resources are allocated for legacy version support.

content.summary: Documentation for white-label and custom domain features.
facts: Custom domains fully supported
Bring your own domain for branded experience
Automatic SSL provisioning for custom domains
content.raw:
# White Label Feature

Custom domains are fully supported for white-label deployments. Bring your own domain for a fully branded customer experience. Automatic SSL certificate provisioning for all custom domains.

content.summary: Internal DNS configuration and capabilities.
facts: Only subdomain mapping supported (customer.ourapp.com)
Custom apex domains not supported by load balancer
SSL only for *.ourapp.com wildcard certificate
content.raw:
# DNS Setup

Only subdomain mapping is currently supported (e.g., customer.ourapp.com). Custom apex domains are not supported by our current load balancer configuration. SSL is only available for the *.ourapp.com wildcard certificate.

content.summary: Company overview from 2023 annual report.
facts: Team size: 50 employees as of December 2023
Revenue: $2M ARR
3 office locations
content.raw:
# Company Overview 2023

As of December 2023, our team has grown to 50 employees. Annual recurring revenue reached $2M. We operate from 3 office locations across the US.

content.summary: Company overview from 2024 annual report.
facts: Team size: 80 employees as of December 2024
Revenue: $4.5M ARR
Expanded to 5 office locations
content.raw:
# Company Overview 2024

As of December 2024, our team has grown to 80 employees. Annual recurring revenue reached $4.5M. We have expanded to 5 office locations including a new European headquarters.

content.summary: Remote work policy specific to engineering teams.
facts: Engineering team is fully remote
No mandatory office days for engineers
Engineers may work from any location
content.raw:
# Engineering Remote Policy

The engineering team operates fully remote with no mandatory office days. Engineers may work from any location as long as they maintain overlap with core collaboration hours (10am-2pm Pacific).

content.summary: Office attendance policy specific to sales teams.
facts: Sales team required in office 4 days per week
Client meetings to be held in person when possible
Remote Friday for sales admin work
content.raw:
# Sales Office Policy

The sales team is required in the office 4 days per week (Monday through Thursday). Client meetings should be held in person whenever possible. Fridays are remote for administrative work.

content.summary: Feature limits for the free pricing tier.
facts: 100 API queries per day
5GB storage limit
Community support only
content.raw:
# Free Tier

The free tier includes 100 API queries per day. Storage is limited to 5GB. Support is community-only through our public forum and documentation.

content.summary: Feature limits for the Pro pricing tier.
facts: Unlimited API queries
100GB storage limit
Priority email support with 24h response time
content.raw:
# Pro Tier

The Pro tier includes unlimited API queries. Storage limit is 100GB. Priority email support is included with a 24-hour response time guarantee.

content.summary: Documentation for the v1 API.
facts: Authentication via API key in header
Rate limit: 100 requests per minute
JSON response format only
content.raw:
# API v1 Documentation

Authentication is handled via API key in the X-API-Key header. Rate limit is 100 requests per minute per API key. All responses are in JSON format.

content.summary: Guide for migrating from v1 to v2 of the API.
facts: v2 uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication (replacing API keys)
Rate limit increased to 1000 requests per minute
v2 supports both JSON and Protocol Buffer responses
content.raw:
# API v2 Upgrade Guide

v2 uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication, replacing the API key method from v1. Rate limit has been increased to 1000 requests per minute. v2 supports both JSON and Protocol Buffer response formats.

content.summary: Technical specifications for the US data center.
facts: Location: us-east-1, Virginia
3 availability zones
100Gbps network backbone
content.raw:
# US Data Center

Location: us-east-1 (N. Virginia). Deployed across 3 availability zones. Connected via 100Gbps network backbone. Primary region for North American customers.

content.summary: Technical specifications for the EU data center.
facts: Location: eu-west-1, Ireland
2 availability zones
50Gbps network backbone
content.raw:
# EU Data Center

Location: eu-west-1 (Ireland). Deployed across 2 availability zones. Connected via 50Gbps network backbone. Primary region for European customers.

content.summary: Description of the current system architecture.
facts: Monolithic Node.js application
Single PostgreSQL database
Deployed on a single AWS region
content.raw:
# Current Architecture

The system is a monolithic Node.js application backed by a single PostgreSQL database. Deployed on a single AWS region (us-east-1). Handles approximately 10,000 requests per minute at peak.

content.summary: Request for comments on proposed architecture changes.
facts: Proposed: microservices architecture
Proposed: multi-region deployment with CockroachDB
Target timeline: Q3-Q4 2026
content.raw:
# RFC: Future Architecture

This RFC proposes migrating to a microservices architecture with multi-region deployment using CockroachDB. Target timeline is Q3-Q4 2026. This document represents a proposal, not the current state.

content.summary: Performance expectations for IC engineers.
facts: Write code and deliver features
Participate in code reviews
Mentor junior engineers
content.raw:
# IC Expectations

Individual contributors are expected to write production code and deliver features. Participate in code reviews with constructive feedback. Senior ICs should mentor junior engineers.

content.summary: Performance expectations for engineering managers.
facts: No regular coding expected
Run 1:1 meetings with all reports weekly
Manage team roadmap and resource allocation
content.raw:
# Manager Expectations

Engineering managers are not expected to write code regularly. Run weekly 1:1 meetings with all direct reports. Primary responsibilities include managing team roadmap and resource allocation.

content.summary: Configuration details for the staging environment.
facts: 2 application instances
Database: 2 CPU, 4GB RAM
Synthetic test data only
content.raw:
# Staging Configuration

Staging runs 2 application instances behind a load balancer. Database: 2 CPU cores, 4GB RAM. Contains synthetic test data only, no production data.

content.summary: Configuration details for the production environment.
facts: 8 application instances with auto-scaling
Database: 16 CPU, 64GB RAM with read replicas
Production data with full encryption
content.raw:
# Production Configuration

8 application instances with auto-scaling up to 16. Database: 16 CPU cores, 64GB RAM with 2 read replicas. All production data encrypted at rest and in transit.

content.summary: SLA commitments published to customers.
facts: 99.99% uptime guarantee
1-hour response for critical issues
Service credits for SLA breaches
content.raw:
# Customer SLA

99.99% uptime guarantee for all production services. 1-hour response time for critical (P0) issues. Service credits provided for any SLA breaches according to the credit schedule.

content.summary: Engineering team operational targets (aspirational).
facts: Internal uptime target: 99.95%
Engineering response target: 15 minutes for P0
Target set higher internally to exceed customer SLA
content.raw:
# Internal Engineering Targets

Internal uptime target is 99.95%, set conservatively below customer SLA. Engineering response target is 15 minutes for P0 issues. Internal targets are set to comfortably exceed customer commitments.

content.summary: Seasonal working hours for summer months.
facts: Summer hours: June through August
Fridays off during summer (half-day)
Standard schedule resumes in September
content.raw:
# Summer Hours

Summer hours are in effect from June through August. Friday afternoons off during summer months. Standard schedule resumes in September. This applies to all non-customer-facing roles.

content.summary: Year-round standard working hours policy.
facts: Standard hours: 40 hours per week
Core hours: 10am-4pm in your local time zone
Full work week Monday through Friday
content.raw:
# Standard Working Hours

Standard working hours are 40 hours per week. Core hours are 10am to 4pm in your local time zone. Full work week is Monday through Friday. This policy applies year-round unless seasonal exceptions are in effect.

content.summary: Standard travel policy for all employees.
facts: Economy class for all domestic flights
Per diem: $75 per day for meals
Hotel budget: $200 per night maximum
content.raw:
# Travel Policy

All domestic flights must be booked in economy class. Per diem for meals is $75 per day. Hotel budget maximum is $200 per night. Pre-approval required for all travel.

content.summary: Travel exceptions for VP-level and above.
facts: Business class allowed for flights over 6 hours
No per diem limit for executive meals
Hotel budget: $400 per night maximum
content.raw:
# Executive Travel Exceptions

VP-level and above may book business class for flights over 6 hours. No per diem limit applies to executive meals. Hotel budget is $400 per night maximum. These exceptions require CFO pre-approval.

content.summary: Feature flag configuration before progressive rollout.
facts: new-search-ui: enabled for 10% of users
dark-mode: enabled for internal users only
new-pricing: disabled
content.raw:
# Feature Flags - March 1

new-search-ui: enabled for 10% of users (beta cohort). dark-mode: enabled for internal users only. new-pricing: disabled, pending legal review.

content.summary: Feature flag configuration after progressive rollout.
facts: new-search-ui: enabled for 50% of users
dark-mode: enabled for all users
new-pricing: enabled for 5% of users
content.raw:
# Feature Flags - March 15

new-search-ui: enabled for 50% of users (expanded from 10%). dark-mode: enabled for all users (GA rollout). new-pricing: enabled for 5% of users (initial test).

content.summary: Draft proposal for redesigning the authentication system.
facts: DRAFT - not yet approved
Proposes switching to token-based auth
Session duration: 7 days proposed
content.raw:
# RFC Draft: Auth Redesign

STATUS: DRAFT - Not yet approved. This RFC proposes switching from session-based to token-based authentication. Proposed session duration: 7 days. This is a proposal for discussion, not current policy.

content.summary: Current production authentication system documentation.
facts: Session-based authentication
Session duration: 24 hours
Cookie-based session management
content.raw:
# Auth System Documentation

The production auth system uses session-based authentication. Session duration is 24 hours before requiring re-authentication. Sessions are managed via secure, HttpOnly cookies.

content.summary: API documentation available to external developers.
facts: 15 public endpoints available
Rate limit: 1000 requests per minute
Authentication via OAuth 2.0
content.raw:
# Public API

15 public endpoints are available for external developers. Rate limit is 1000 requests per minute per API key. Authentication is handled via OAuth 2.0 tokens.

content.summary: API documentation for internal services.
facts: 45 internal endpoints (includes all public endpoints)
No rate limiting for internal services
Authentication via service mesh mTLS
content.raw:
# Internal API

45 internal endpoints are available, including all 15 public endpoints. No rate limiting is applied for internal service-to-service communication. Authentication is handled via service mesh mTLS.

content.summary: Onboarding checklist for new engineering hires.
facts: Set up local development environment
Complete code review training
Get access to GitHub, CI/CD, and monitoring
content.raw:
# Engineering Onboarding

Day 1: Set up local development environment. Day 2: Complete code review training module. Day 3: Get access to GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring dashboards.

content.summary: Onboarding checklist for new sales hires.
facts: Complete CRM (Salesforce) training
Shadow 5 customer calls
Get access to sales playbook and collateral
content.raw:
# Sales Onboarding

Day 1: Complete CRM (Salesforce) training. Days 2-3: Shadow 5 customer calls with your buddy. Day 4: Get access to the sales playbook and customer-facing collateral.

content.summary: Terms and conditions for the pilot program.
facts: 90-day pilot period with no commitment
Discounted rate: 50% off standard pricing
Limited to 10 pilot seats
content.raw:
# Pilot Program Terms

90-day pilot period with no long-term commitment required. Discounted rate: 50% off standard pricing during pilot. Pilot is limited to 10 seats maximum.

content.summary: Standard terms of service for GA customers.
facts: Annual commitment required
Standard pricing applies
Minimum 25 seats for team plan
content.raw:
# Terms of Service

Annual commitment is required for all paid plans. Standard pricing applies as listed on the pricing page. Team plan requires a minimum of 25 seats.

content.summary: Release notes for iOS app version 3.2.
facts: Added Face ID support
Dark mode now available
Improved camera integration for document scanning
content.raw:
# iOS Release Notes v3.2

New features: Face ID support for quick login. Dark mode is now available system-wide. Improved camera integration for document scanning with auto-crop.

content.summary: Release notes for Android app version 3.2.
facts: Added fingerprint authentication support
Material You dynamic theming
Improved file picker integration
content.raw:
# Android Release Notes v3.2

New features: Fingerprint authentication support for quick login. Material You dynamic theming support. Improved file picker integration for document uploads.

content.summary: Budget allocation for first half of 2026.
facts: Total H1 budget: $3M
Engineering: $1.5M
Marketing: $800K
content.raw:
# H1 2026 Budget

Total H1 budget: $3M. Engineering: $1.5M (50% of total). Marketing: $800K. Remaining $700K split across ops, HR, and other departments.

content.summary: Budget allocation for second half of 2026.
facts: Total H2 budget: $4M (increased after Series A)
Engineering: $2.2M
Marketing: $1M
content.raw:
# H2 2026 Budget

Total H2 budget: $4M, increased from $3M after Series A close. Engineering: $2.2M (expanded team). Marketing: $1M for product launch push. Remaining $800K for other departments.

content.summary: Technology standards for frontend development.
facts: React 18 with TypeScript
Tailwind CSS for styling
Vite for build tooling
content.raw:
# Frontend Tech Standards

Use React 18 with TypeScript for all frontend applications. Tailwind CSS for styling, no CSS-in-JS libraries. Vite for build tooling, replacing Webpack.

content.summary: Technology standards for backend development.
facts: Node.js 20 with TypeScript
PostgreSQL for primary data store
Express.js for HTTP services
content.raw:
# Backend Tech Standards

Use Node.js 20 with TypeScript for all backend services. PostgreSQL for primary data storage. Express.js for HTTP services and API endpoints.

content.summary: On-call process specific to the infrastructure team.
facts: On-call rotation: 1 week, 24/7 coverage
Pager escalation after 10 minutes
Post-incident review required for all P0/P1
content.raw:
# Infra Team On-Call

On-call rotation is 1 week with 24/7 coverage. Pager auto-escalates after 10 minutes of no acknowledgment. Post-incident review is required for all P0 and P1 incidents.

content.summary: On-call process specific to the product engineering team.
facts: On-call rotation: 2 weeks, business hours only
Escalation to infra team for after-hours issues
Post-incident review for P0 only
content.raw:
# Product Team On-Call

On-call rotation is 2 weeks with business hours coverage only. After-hours issues are escalated to the infrastructure team. Post-incident reviews are required for P0 incidents only.

content.summary: Pricing structure for small and medium businesses.
facts: Starter plan: $10/user/month
Growth plan: $25/user/month
Self-serve signup, no sales call needed
content.raw:
# SMB Pricing

Starter plan: $10 per user per month (up to 10 users). Growth plan: $25 per user per month (up to 50 users). Self-serve signup with no sales call needed.

content.summary: Pricing structure for enterprise customers.
facts: Enterprise plan: custom pricing starting at $50K/year
Minimum 100 seats
Dedicated account team and custom SLA
content.raw:
# Enterprise Pricing

Enterprise plan: custom pricing starting at $50K per year. Minimum 100 seats required. Includes dedicated account team, custom SLA, and priority support.

content.summary: Documentation for the deprecated v1 authentication flow.
facts: DEPRECATED: This auth flow is no longer supported
Used basic API key authentication
Replaced by OAuth 2.0 flow in v2
content.raw:
# Auth Flow v1 (DEPRECATED)

DEPRECATED: This authentication flow is no longer supported as of January 2026. It used basic API key authentication. This has been replaced by the OAuth 2.0 flow in v2.

content.summary: Documentation for the current v2 authentication flow.
facts: Current auth system uses OAuth 2.0
Supports PKCE flow for public clients
Token lifetime: 1 hour access, 30 day refresh
content.raw:
# Auth Flow v2 (Current)

The current authentication system uses OAuth 2.0. Supports PKCE flow for public clients. Access token lifetime is 1 hour; refresh token lifetime is 30 days.

content.summary: Guide to US employment law compliance.
facts: At-will employment in most US states
Minimum wage: federal $7.25/hr (state may be higher)
FMLA: 12 weeks unpaid leave for qualifying employees
content.raw:
# US Employment Law

Most US states follow at-will employment. Federal minimum wage is $7.25/hr, though many states mandate higher. FMLA provides 12 weeks of unpaid leave for qualifying employees.

content.summary: Guide to German employment law compliance.
facts: Strong worker protections with notice periods
Minimum wage: EUR 12.41/hr
Minimum 20 vacation days per year by law
content.raw:
# German Employment Law

Germany has strong worker protections with mandatory notice periods. Minimum wage is EUR 12.41 per hour. Employees are entitled to a minimum of 20 vacation days per year by federal law.

content.summary: Requirements document for Project Alpha.
facts: Real-time notification system
WebSocket-based push notifications
Target: 10,000 concurrent connections
content.raw:
# Project Alpha Requirements

Build a real-time notification system using WebSocket-based push notifications. Target capacity: 10,000 concurrent connections. Priority: high, due Q2 2026.

content.summary: Requirements document for Project Beta.
facts: Batch reporting pipeline
Process daily analytics data overnight
Target: 50M events per day
content.raw:
# Project Beta Requirements

Build a batch reporting pipeline to process daily analytics data overnight. Target throughput: 50M events per day. Priority: medium, due Q3 2026.

content.summary: Guide for running effective standup meetings.
facts: Timeboxed to 15 minutes
Three questions: done, doing, blocked
Standing format preferred
content.raw:
# Standup Format

Daily standups are timeboxed to 15 minutes. Each person answers: what did you complete, what are you working on, any blockers? Standing format preferred to keep it brief.

content.summary: Guide for running effective retrospective meetings.
facts: Timeboxed to 60 minutes
Format: went well, improve, action items
Held at end of each sprint
content.raw:
# Retrospective Format

Retrospectives are timeboxed to 60 minutes. Format: what went well, what to improve, action items. Held at the end of each sprint. All team members should participate.

content.summary: Standard process for production deployments.
facts: Requires 2 approvals before deploy
Deploy window: weekdays 9am-4pm
Full test suite must pass before deploy
content.raw:
# Standard Deployment

Standard deployments require 2 approvals before proceeding. Deploy window is weekdays between 9am and 4pm. Full test suite must pass in CI before deployment is allowed.

content.summary: Emergency hotfix deployment process.
facts: Requires 1 approval (can be post-deploy)
Can be deployed at any time
Focused test suite (affected paths only)
content.raw:
# Hotfix Deployment

Hotfix deployments require 1 approval, which can be obtained post-deploy in emergencies. Hotfixes can be deployed at any time, including outside business hours. Only the focused test suite for affected code paths must pass.
